scale.1: Unusable or contradicts the confirmed requirement
scale.4: Meets confirmed requirement with minor concerns

character_policy: N/A when the case has no character requirement; omit, never assign zero.
blinding: Rate source/reference and anonymized output without provider, variant, prompt or checker conclusion. Keep output-to-run mapping in a separate restricted file.
disagreement: Retain every independent rating. Report conflicting run/category labels and require human adjudication before a release decision. Missing judgments remain unmeasured.
meaning: Scores are ordinal reviewer observations, not probabilities of correctness or measures of sales or virality.
